name: soundHandle
meaning: handle of the running / rolling sound (0x8d while a switch drives it, 0xf5 while it turns); 0 = none (Wheel_SetState 0x50862e)

name: state
meaning: 0 stopped, 1 switch on, 2 free to turn, 3 held by msg 0x43 arg 1, 4 switch off / returning (Wheel_SetState 0x50862e)

name: liftLoaded
meaning: 1 while one of the four lifts overlaps the Wolf (Wheel_ScanLift 0x50889b via Wheel_UpdateSpin 0x5089d2); selects the loaded torque constants

name: wolfAtHub
meaning: 1 while the Wolf overlaps the wheel's own model box, tested only once the glow is at least half up (0x5081e7)

name: loadedLift
meaning: index 0..3 of the lift that carries the Wolf (0x5089e0)

name: railStart
meaning: the position the wheel returns to along the rail: the placed position, refreshed by state 0 and by msg 0x43 arg != 1 (0x50866d)

name: homePos
meaning: placed position; Reset copies it back into railStart (0x507e1c)

name: railPos
meaning: the position reached along the rail, refreshed after every move (0x50905b)

name: homeRot
meaning: placed rotation; Reset restores spin from it and re-places the lifts (0x507e46)

name: spin
meaning: the wheel's working rotation, all three axes masked to 12 bits; +0x6a is the spin angle that Wheel_UpdateSpin advances (0x508aa4)

name: liftBoxSize
meaning: (0, lift model box height, 0): added to each lift's world box in Wheel_PlaceLifts (0x507c96)

name: armRadius
meaning: half the height of the wheel's own model box plus 30: the radius at which the lifts are placed (0x507a7a)

name: spinStep
meaning: angle added to the spin this frame, from Wheel_ComputeSpinStep 0x508aff; also sent to the MOBIL as msg 0x42's argument

name: switchAngle
meaning: PROPERTY_WHEEL_SWITCHANGLE, moved one unit away from zero by PostLoadInit (0x507b9b); read nowhere else in the class

name: translation
meaning: PROPERTY_WHEEL_TRANSLATION: the distance the wheel may travel along its rail (0x507b5c)

name: railTravel
meaning: XZ distance from railStart to the current position (Vec3s_DistXZ 0x508e59); the move stops at `translation`

name: glow
meaning: 0..1000 ramp driven by g_dtMs*1000 / (raisingTime/2): rises while the wheel is past half its travel, falls back otherwise. Scaled to 0..0x1000 as the tint amount of the wheel and its four lifts

name: railStartSet
meaning: latched the first time state 0 records railStart so that a later stop does not move it (0x50869e)

name: raisingTime
meaning: PROPERTY_WHEEL_RAISINGTIME in ms: the time the rail move and the glow ramp take (0x507a3b)

name: hubBox
meaning: the wheel's own model box in world space, its top raised by 10, used for the hub overlap query (0x50802a-0x508177)

name: overlap
meaning: ObjGrid_QueryBoxOverlap output buffer shared by the hub query and the per-lift query (0x510f34 calls at 0x508192 and 0x5088cc)

name: overlapCount
meaning: number of objects the last overlap query returned

name: lifts
meaning: PROPERTY_WHEEL_LIFT0..LIFT3 (Scn_GetPropObject 0x507bd6-0x507c2c). In Lvl-12 these are WheelDummy objects (class 112): the code writes their +0x50 / +0x52 phase angles and their +0x44..+0x4f world box

name: mobil
meaning: PROPERTY_WHEEL_MOBIL (0x507b3a): receives msg 0x42 with the frame's spin step while a lift is loaded (0x508af8)

name: switchSender
meaning: first sender of MSG_SWITCH_ON / MSG_SWITCH_OFF; passed on to the boss in the msg 0x42 argument (0x50851b)

name: boss
meaning: the level's Gossamer_Boss (class 113), found by scanning g_scnObjects (0x507b0f); told when the wheel starts and stops moving

name: bossMsgSender
meaning: first word of the msg 0x42 argument sent to the boss: switchSender (0x508724)

name: bossMsgOn
meaning: second word: 1 when the wheel starts its rail move (state 2), 0 when it returns (state 4)
